title: TaoChronos acupuncture reasoning and audit contracts (study.acupuncture_reason, study.acupuncture_audit)
description: Parameter and return contracts of the two tools, adopted from the TaoChronos Acupuncture Tool Design Package 1.0 (29 October 2026) and adapted for the integrated implementation (docs/adr/0026-acupuncture-reasoning-contracts.md): the tools are registered; artifact_type, production_integration and source_registry_ref name this implementation; mode may be null when the call is rejected; returns may carry the TaoChronos additions notice, evidence, analogies, directions, limits, review, summary (reason) and plan_review, claims_review, evidence, notice, summary (audit); relation_type adds organ_orifice, channel_course, functional_direction and analogy.  Everything else is the package's.

assessmentStatus.description: null indicates that execution has not completed and no assessment has been made; no_applicable_rule must not substitute for invalid parameters or an unavailable dependency.

recorded_at.description: Record a timestamp with its time zone when known; retain null when unknown.

valid_from.description: Record a timestamp with its time zone when known; retain null when unknown.

valid_until.description: Record a timestamp with its time zone when known; retain null when unknown.

entity.description: Record the zang-fu entity separately from its yin, yang, or other functional aspect; a Five-Phase label must not replace the entity identifier.

subject_ref.description: Compare with case.case_subject_ref; facts about a relative, a literature case, or another person must not be attributed to this case.

state.description: mixed preserves coexisting excess and deficiency; neither_excess_nor_deficiency must be explicitly established. balanced is a general description of balance and does not automatically satisfy the neither-excess-nor-deficiency premise in Difficulty 69 of the Nanjing.

organState.description: phase_annotation is a lookup annotation only; organ_entity and yin_yang_aspect must not be discarded when matching clinical premises.

max_candidate_points.description: A candidate display budget only, not a treatment point count or clinical limit. Complete guard and conflict checks before paginating or truncating eligible candidates; retain the count of undisplayed candidates and do not truncate safety findings.

requested_methods.description: Omission and [] both mean that no point-selection method will run for this request; neither falls back to all. Knowledge lookup, case routing, and claim auditing may continue. An empty value does not by itself trigger a question asking the user to select a method. If the natural-language request explicitly specifies a method, the caller should place the confirmed method ID in this array; query must not override an explicitly empty array.

review_context_ref.description: An opaque reference to a server-side record. Accept the reference only, not client-supplied trust flags, signature results, or verified states. The server must check the requesting principal, case version and digest, and authorized purpose.

reasonParameters.description: requested_methods rejects unknown values; invalid filters must not fall back to all. Normalize the input alias SJ to TE.

requested_methods.description: Omission and [] both mean that no point-selection method will run for this request; neither falls back to all. Knowledge lookup, case routing, and claim auditing may continue. An empty value does not by itself trigger a question asking the user to select a method. If the natural-language request explicitly specifies a method, the caller should place the confirmed method ID in this array; query must not override an explicitly empty array.

review_context_ref.description: An opaque reference to a server-side record. Accept the reference only, not client-supplied trust flags, signature results, or verified states. The server must check the requesting principal, case version and digest, and authorized purpose.

patternHypothesis.description: No diagnosis_probability is provided; rule-match strength must not be represented as a clinical probability.

candidatePoint.description: channel_phase, point_phase, intent, and modality are independent fields. Use TE as the canonical Sanjiao channel code in point identifiers.

traceStep.description: An auditable summary of supporting information, not the model's hidden reasoning process.

must_include_educational_mappings.description: A summary of the point and intention in an educational mapping; distinct from must_include_candidates.

acceptanceCase.description: request.arguments intentionally permits invalid-contract fixtures; expected.request_schema_valid specifies whether the request should be accepted or rejected.

state.description: mixed preserves coexisting excess and deficiency; neither_excess_nor_deficiency must be explicitly established. balanced is a general description of balance and does not automatically satisfy the neither-excess-nor-deficiency premise in Difficulty 69 of the Nanjing.

premiseClaim.description: An unverified premise claim supplied in a request. reviewer_kind and claimed_accepted retain the user's statements only and cannot authorize execution. Trusted review must be loaded and verified through the server-side review_context_ref.

trustedReviewRecord.description: Defines an internal server-side record structure for implementers only; it is not part of any public tool.parameters. The server must load an authorized persistent record and verify identity and record integrity. String constants do not themselves establish trust. domain_reviewer may authorize educational use only.

educationalMapping.description: A separate educational mapping: an explicitly hypothetical premise and an explicit method are sufficient, without clinical review. It must not be recorded as a real-case candidate, clinical evidence, or a procedure order.

x-validation-boundary: JSON Schema validates structure; it cannot establish that a clinical premise is true, a relationship is correct, or a treatment is effective.
Additional structural checks are required for end>=start in original-text spans, consistency between text and offsets, and source foreign keys.
The rule DSL contains no eval, scripts, arbitrary functions, or dynamic network calls.
clinical_condition identifiers are explicitly separate from diagnosis_probability; this contract provides no probability field.

trustedReviewRecord is an internal server-only structure. Attempts to inject trusted_server_fixture or verified=true into ordinary tool arguments must be rejected by additionalProperties=false. The existence of a reference does not establish authorization.
Only assessment_status=candidate_review may contain nonempty point_candidates. Mappings in knowledge mode belong in educational_mappings, with clinical truth status not_asserted.

The max_candidate_points default of 6 is a display budget only. Count consistency, pagination, and truncation require implementation-level checks; this does not recommend using six points for treatment.

When execution is incomplete, return assessment_status=null. Separate validation records report full Draft 2020-12 validation and runtime rule verification; this deliverable does not presume the validation environment's outcome.
